task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the abdominal CT scan into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 3D Slicer or similar medical imaging interface showing axial, sagittal, and coronal views of an abdominal CT scan.

task_completion.description: The agent performs a linear measurement of the maximum tumor diameter.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement ruler or markup line placed across the largest dimension of the tumor (label 2) in the slice viewer.

task_completion.description: The agent measures the distance from the tumor to the renal sinus or collecting system (N component).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement tool showing the distance between the tumor boundary and the kidney hilum/sinus.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurement markups to the specified file path: ~/Documents/SlicerData/KiTS/agent_measurements.mrk.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser window, terminal output, or 'Save' dialog showing the specific file path and filename being written.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the individual R, E, N, A, and L scores based on the measurements.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A report, notepad, or terminal showing the breakdown of the five RENAL components and their assigned point values.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final JSON report with all required fields to ~/Documents/SlicerData/KiTS/renal_score_report.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal displaying the final JSON structure containing fields like tumor_side, R_score, total_score, and complexity.

integrity.description: The agent used the imaging software GUI to perform measurements rather than just writing a script to generate the report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with measurement tools, sliders, or markup buttons in the 3D Slicer interface.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the expected values into a file without performing the visual analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating through different CT slices to find the maximum diameter and hilar proximity before writing the report.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual application rather than a simulated or static image.
integrity.visual_evidence: Changes in the UI state, such as crosshair movement, slice number changes, or zooming/panning within the CT viewer.
